consent.bannerText: We use strictly necessary cookies to run Evalorio: keeping you signed in, protecting forms against bots and remembering this choice. With your permission we also measure, anonymously, how the site is used so we can improve it. Nothing optional is used until you decide, and you can change your mind at any time from “Cookie settings” at the bottom of every page. More in our <cookies>cookie policy</cookies> and <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
consent.settingsIntro: Choose which optional categories you allow. Strictly necessary ones cannot be switched off because the site does not work without them. Details in the <cookies>cookie policy</cookies>.

necessary.title: Strictly necessary
necessary.description: Sign-in, security against bots and abuse, remembering your cookie choice, loading the map. Exempt from consent under the ePrivacy rules.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Remember choices you make so the site feels the way you left it.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Anonymous statistics about which pages are visited, so we can improve Evalorio. No cookies, no advertising profiles, nothing shared with advertisers.

marketing.title: Marketing
marketing.description: Measure advertising campaigns and show relevant ads on other sites.

authToken.purpose: Keeps you signed in securely after you log in. May be split into several numbered parts (.0, .1…) when the session is large.
authToken.duration: Until you log out (renewed while you use the site)

authVerifier.purpose: Protects the sign-in flow (proof key used once).

consent.purpose: Remembers your cookie choices so we don't ask again.

turnstile.purpose: Checks that forms (sign-up, messages, reports) are sent by a person, not a bot.
turnstile.duration: No cookie on our domain; processed by Cloudflare when a form is shown
turnstile.name: Anti-bot check (Turnstile)

mapTiles.purpose: Loads the map images; the map server receives your IP address to send them.
mapTiles.name: Map images

vercelAnalytics.purpose: Counts page views anonymously (a daily changing hash instead of an identifier).
vercelAnalytics.name: Web Analytics

privacyRequest.title: Your privacy rights
privacyRequest.intro: Under the GDPR you can ask us at any time to access, correct, delete, restrict or transfer your data, or object to how we use it. We answer within one month.
privacyRequest.selfService: Signed in? You can download all your data or delete your account yourself in <settings>Settings</settings>, instantly.
privacyRequest.type: What would you like to do?

types.access: Get a copy of my data (access)
types.restriction: Pause the use of my data (restriction)
types.portability: Receive my data in a machine-readable format (portability)
types.objection: Object to a use of my data (objection)
